2. This writ petition has been filed for the following reliefs:
"For issuance of an appropriate writ/rule/order/direction commanding upon the respondents and directing them to make payment of the amount of compensation to the petitioner along with interest and solatium thereon in accordance with the provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 on account of acquisition of the lands measuring an area of 0.71 acres out of plot no. 1533 of khata no. 47 situated at village Diyakel, P.O. and P.S. Torpa, District Khunti in the State of Jharkhand exclusively belonging to the petitioner and the petitioner further prays that the Executive Engineer, Road construction Department, Road Division, Khunti, the respondent no.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that no compensation has been paid in connection with the property acquired by virtue of the Land Acquisition Case No. 7 of 1958-59 which he claims to be belonging to the petitioner.

4. A counter-affidavit has been filed in the present case to submit that the petitioner is not entitled to any compensation as because compensation has already been paid to the awardees on 29.02.1960 and in support of such averment, order sheet has been annexed along with the counter-affidavit.
5. No rejoinder to the counter affidavit has been filed by the petitioner.
6. Considering the aforesaid stand taken through the counter affidavit supported by the order-sheet annexed with the counter affidavit, this court does not find any merits in the present case.
7. This writ petition is accordingly dismissed.
8. Pending interlocutory application, if any, is closed.
